mentions.name: Strengthara
mentions.description: A web admin panel and iOS app for planning and editing workouts, nutrition, and training programs, replicating the functionality of a personal trainer's coaching app with the concept of coaching yourself or others. The author is turning it into a SaaS ahead of a planned launch after summer.
mentions.problem: Replacing a personal-trainer-provided app without being locked in or having to buy more coaching sessions, while still being able to edit their own and their wife's workouts and nutrition.
mentions.audience: SaaS app for people to coach themselves or others, sparked by interest from coworkers and friends
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on an application to replace the app i got from when i had a personal trainer. I wanted to be able to edit my own and my wifes workouts, nutrition etc without being locked in and buying more sessions.
